newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary 1-mth BUBOR flat, 3-mth, 6-mth edges down.
newsitem.headline: Hungary 1-mth BUBOR flat, 3-mth, 6-mth edges down.

text.p: Hungary's Budapest Interbank Offered Rates (BUBOR) remained steady for the one-month maturity and eased for the three- and six-month maturities, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on its BUBOR Reuters page on Wednesday.
The one-month rate was set at 21.28 percent, unchanged, the three-month rate at 21.15 percent, down 0.03 and the six-month rate at 21.02 percent, down 0.01.
